notes: Stories created for multi-cluster Mongo routing governance aligned to ADR-0006.

BL-0.1.4-010-S1.title: Define Multi-Cluster Routing Schema and Contract
BL-0.1.4-010-S1.description: Define configuration schema for routing rules between MongoDB clusters including cluster identifiers, environment prefixes, collection mappings, and failover behavior.

BL-0.1.4-010-S2.title: Implement Cluster Routing Decision Engine
BL-0.1.4-010-S2.description: Implement core logic that determines which MongoDB cluster to route to based on request context (environment, dataset type, operation type) using the defined routing contract.

BL-0.1.4-010-S3.title: Integrate Routing Engine with MongoDB Utilities
BL-0.1.4-010-S3.description: Integrate routing logic into shared MongoDB connection utilities so all read/write operations automatically resolve to the correct cluster without caller awareness.

BL-0.1.4-010-S4.title: Expose Routing Configuration and Health Signals
BL-0.1.4-010-S4.description: Provide internal API or debug hooks to expose active cluster routing decisions and health status for observability and troubleshooting.

BL-0.1.4-010-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Multi-Cluster Routing
BL-0.1.4-010-S5.description: Create tests validating correct routing decisions, failover handling, and end-to-end integration with Mongo utilities across both clusters.

BL-0.1.4-010.mitigation: Default to primary cluster on routing ambiguity and log all routing decisions for traceability.
